title: Voya Retirement Account
description: Schema representing a Voya Financial retirement plan account.

accountId.description: Unique identifier for the retirement account.

planId.description: Identifier for the employer-sponsored retirement plan.

planType.description: Type of retirement or savings plan.

participantId.description: Unique identifier for the plan participant.

accountBalance.description: Current total account balance in USD.

vestedBalance.description: Vested portion of account balance in USD.

employerMatchYTD.description: Year-to-date employer matching contributions in USD.

deferralRate.description: Employee contribution deferral rate as percentage of salary.

enrollmentDate.description: Date the participant enrolled in the plan.

lastUpdated.description: Timestamp of the last account update.
